### [![Download Blazify for Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download_Blazify_9.18.0-FFA726?style=for-the-badge&logoColor=1A0E00&logo=android)](https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/releases/download/v9.18.0/Blazify-gms.apk) **One click. No choosing.** That button gives you the build for an ordinary phone: everything Blazify does, casting to a Chromecast, a smart speaker or a television included, and it tells you when there is a new version. On a phone with no Google services (de-Googled, LineageOS, a Huawei), take [Blazify.apk](https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/releases/download/v9.18.0/Blazify.apk) below instead: the same app, without playing to a television.
--- ## Highlights - **Songs no longer stop about 30 seconds in.** On phones where YouTube's token can't be made, the song now comes from a source that needs none and plays to the end, and a stream refused mid-song carries on from the same second ([#23](https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/issues/23)) - **Half the download:** about 14 MB instead of 29 MB. The Japanese reading dictionary is fetched only when you ask for Japanese lyrics in English letters, and Home's pictures are smaller files - **Music keeps going without a connection:** on Wi-Fi the next three songs are saved to the phone, and with no connection the queue goes on with songs that are there instead of stopping - **Offline, Home plays what you have:** the shuffle button, For you and Speed dial play the songs saved on your phone, shuffled, instead of an online radio that fails - **Sync a song's plain lyrics yourself:** tap along as it plays and the lines light up in time from then on ## New features - Remove from queue in a song's menu, not only by swiping it away - Discord shows Blazify as what you are listening on - The Ring player has shuffle on the left and repeat on the right, with the standard play button, so the controls stay put when the lyrics open - Spanish has every newer text, for Spain and Latin America, and the last English words in screens follow the app's language ## Fixes and improvements - **The search screen no longer breaks after you delete a search:** Recent searches and Browse show cleanly instead of over the old results ([#24](https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/issues/24)) - A song YouTube turns away with a "confirm you're not a bot" check is asked for again with a fresh session, instead of being skipped as unavailable - Going back while editing a search returns to its results with the words they belong to - Last.fm scrobbling works again (in the F-Droid build, add your own Last.fm key) - Shuffle with crossfade keeps one shuffled order instead of repeating songs and skipping others - With explicit songs or videos hidden, tapping a song in a list plays that song, not the one that moved into its place - A playlist sorted by artist keeps each artist's songs together, ordered by album - Lyrics: outside full screen the current line sits a little lower, so the line just sung no longer hides behind the Sources button - Equalizer graph: negative dB labels keep their minus sign, and the 100, 1k and 10k labels are no longer cut in half - The playback error report shows the real time of the error - Release builds no longer include a design-preview screen that other apps could open --- **Also on this page:** `Blazify.apk` for phones without Google services, and `Blazify-izzy-9.18.0.apk`, the build with no updater for F-Droid-style repositories. **Full changelog**: https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/compare/v9.17.0...v9.18.0
